dazhongsi_georeferenced_design_feature_c.formula: count(all geometry_role=design_proposal features with positive-dimensional or point containment overlap with PROV-KEY-003 in EPSG:4548)
assumptions: PROV-KEY-003 remains only as a non-design provisional hold mask because its published repository position is disputed; FIG.03 instead provides a non-georeferenced, non-boundary and non-quantitative four-quadrant concept covering function, building action, mobility, public space, operations, and start conditions.

dazhongsi_public_context_feature_count.formula: count(OSM road, railway, transit-stop, station-access, and building context features tagged PUBLIC-ANCHOR-DZS)
assumptions: Orientation context only under ODbL; not the 72-hectare key-area boundary, a survey base, or a design-area measurement.

dazhongsi_design_overlap_area_sqm.formula: sum(area(design_proposal feature intersection PROV-KEY-003)) in EPSG:4548

dazhongsi_design_overlap_length_m.formula: sum(length(design_proposal feature intersection PROV-KEY-003)) in EPSG:4548

dazhongsi_hold_partition_piece_count.formula: count(land_use topology pieces where zone_id=DZHOLD and geometry_role=provisional_constraint)
assumptions: These pieces close the topology only; they carry no land-use, phasing, road, station, or development proposal.

total_floor_area_sqm.reason: Approved parcel controls and verified existing floor area are unavailable.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site polygon are unavailable.

road_area_ratio.reason: Official road redlines and site polygon are unavailable.

official_building_height_m.reason: Approved height controls and applicable constraint layers are unavailable.

official_setback_m.reason: Road, fire-control, municipal and heritage setback controls are unavailable.

ai_innovation_index.formula: sum(normalized_dimension_score * approved_dimension_weight) across research, enterprise, talent, testing, technology-transfer, and public service dimensions
ai_innovation_index.reason: No officially adopted local baseline, weights, reporting year, or verified input series is available.
ai_innovation_index.activation_condition: The competent authority approves the indicator dimensions, weights, reporting year, study boundary, and auditable input series.

ai_talent_density.formula: verified full-time AI R&D and technical-service personnel / verified AI industry and research gross floor area in hectares
ai_talent_density.reason: Employer-level aggregate personnel counts and verified AI-space floor areas are unavailable.
ai_talent_density.measurement_unit: persons per hectare of verified AI industry and research floor area
ai_talent_density.activation_condition: Use aggregated, non-personal employer records for one reporting year and a verified floor-area inventory within the same boundary.

ai_industry_output_value.formula: sum(audited annual operating revenue or officially defined output value of eligible AI entities within the study boundary), with duplicate legal entities removed
ai_industry_output_value.reason: An official statistical definition, reporting-year enterprise roster, and auditable financial or statistical series are unavailable.
ai_industry_output_value.activation_condition: The statistics authority confirms the output definition, eligible entity roster, boundary, reporting year, and de-duplication rule.

ai_enterprise_cluster_density.formula: count(distinct verified active AI enterprises with an operating site inside the official boundary) / official study area in square kilometres
ai_enterprise_cluster_density.reason: A verified, de-duplicated enterprise roster and official study polygon are unavailable.
ai_enterprise_cluster_density.measurement_unit: active AI enterprises per square kilometre
ai_enterprise_cluster_density.activation_condition: Confirm the AI-enterprise eligibility rule, active status, operating address, reporting date, and official polygon.

ai_industry_space_area_sqm.formula: sum(verified gross floor area assigned to eligible AI research, testing, incubation, enterprise service, and supporting production uses)
ai_industry_space_area_sqm.reason: No building-level existing-use survey, tenancy roster, ownership record, or verified gross-floor-area dataset is available.
ai_industry_space_area_sqm.activation_condition: Complete a building and tenancy inventory with surveyed floor area, use, vacancy, rights, and operating status.

ai_industry_space_ratio.reason: Both the eligible AI-space area and regional total building floor area are unavailable.
ai_industry_space_ratio.activation_condition: Activate only after both numerator and denominator use the same official boundary, survey date, and gross-floor-area convention.

regional_total_building_floor_area_sqm.formula: sum(verified existing gross floor area within the official overall-design boundary)
regional_total_building_floor_area_sqm.reason: Existing-building survey, approved floor-area records, and the official overall-design polygon are unavailable.
regional_total_building_floor_area_sqm.activation_condition: Reconcile survey, planning-permit, completion-acceptance, and building-register records against the official polygon.

renewal_potential_area_sqm.formula: sum(parcel or building areas classified through verified retain, repair, adapt, replace, or public-realm-improvement screening)
renewal_potential_area_sqm.reason: Building condition, use efficiency, vacancy, ownership, heritage, infrastructure capacity, and regulatory constraints are unavailable at parcel level.
renewal_potential_area_sqm.activation_condition: Complete site survey and multi-department verification before assigning any parcel or building to a renewal class.

live_work_learning_service_completeness.formula: 100 * count(accessibly reachable categories among work, housing, daily service, learning, and recreation) / 5, assessed by verified walking network and agreed time threshold
live_work_learning_service_completeness.reason: A verified facility inventory, accessible walking network, residential and employment data, and an approved travel-time threshold are unavailable.
live_work_learning_service_completeness.activation_condition: Agree the five-category facility standard and travel-time threshold, then validate facilities, entrances, opening hours, capacity, and accessible routes.
